name: year
description: Calendar year in which the survey financial year ends
observations: Partition column; the 2019-20 Survey of Income and Housing is stored as 2020

name: survey_year
description: Australian financial year the estimate refers to in YYYY-YY format
observations: Runs 1 July to 30 June; the Survey of Income and Housing is biennial so the series steps two years at a time

name: geography
observations: Australia for most tables; cube 13 covers states and territories greater capital city areas and rest of state; cube 14 covers one state or territory per table. No directory link because the values mix three geographic levels and ABS publishes no code for them here

name: geography_level
observations: One of national state or territory greater capital city area rest of state

name: source_table_id
description: Number of the ABS data cube table the estimate is published in
observations: Such as 10.2 for the second table of cube 10. Table numbers are specific to the 2019-20 release: ABS renumbers its cubes between releases

name: source_table_name
description: Title of the ABS data cube table the estimate is published in

name: breakdown_type
description: Population characteristic the estimate is broken down by
observations: Total where the estimate covers all households or persons

name: breakdown_value
description: Category of the breakdown the estimate refers to
observations: Verbatim ABS category label; where ABS groups categories the group and the category are joined with a greater-than sign as in 65 YEARS AND OVER > 65-74

name: measure
observations: Verbatim ABS row or column label; where ABS nests labels the levels are joined with a greater-than sign as in Household net worth > Mean net worth

name: measurement_unit
description: Unit the estimate is expressed in
observations: One of $ $'000 % '000 ratio no. years hours as published by ABS

name: estimate
observations: Null where ABS did not publish a number; the reason is then given in estimate_flag. No fixed measurement unit because it varies by row and is given in measurement_unit

name: estimate_flag
description: Marker ABS published in place of a value
observations: Null where an estimate was published

name: relative_standard_error
description: Relative standard error of the estimate
observations: Null where ABS published no relative standard error for the estimate; ABS considers an estimate with a relative standard error above 50% too unreliable for general use

name: margin_of_error
description: 95% margin of error of the estimate
observations: Published for proportions in place of a relative standard error. Expressed in the same unit as the estimate so it carries no fixed measurement unit
